Hi Kikirio, love your work across all the mods. My modding background is with C# (primarily in Space Engineers, individual scripts compiled at runtime not in .dlls) so I’m on the learning curve here especially with the obfuscation.

I’m hoping to add buffs and debuffs to medkits to change effects to heal-over-time with consequences (hydration increase, etc) similar to stims. I see the debuffs but am yet to find a healthrate buff.

My question is: as the parenting is different for stims and medical items, is it impossible to make this change server-side only because properties of medkits are limited to “instant” effects?

Appreciate the advice, keen to learn more.
